name: Wm. H. Taylor
trade: boot, shoe and leather store, wholesale and retail, and boots and shoes made to order
goods: ladies' gaiter, prunella and morocco boots

proprietors.name: Wm. H. Taylor
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card taylor_william_h (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names Dearborn Street and nothing narrower; the anchor "Messrs. Newberry & Dole's Store" names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-05-20, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read yankee: Wm. H. Taylor (yankee). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
